Row.Text: With the heart and stomach of a lion, I will reign a queen who loves and is loved by her people.
I greet you prince to prince and offer such welcome as deserved.

You have injured and offended me with no reparation. All that remains is to war.
I take foul scorn that any prince should dare to invade the borders of my realm.
Fortune, that blind wretch, hast conquered me.
The manner of your petition I do well like.
Go, go, go seek some otherwhere; importune me no more.
A fair exchange is a boon to both realms.
In your brain beats a hammer of vain judgment.
Victory is a just reward for virtue.
